description: This Java class 'DefaultTbDeviceService' implements device management operations such as save, delete, assign, unassign, claim, and reclaim for devices within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with device services, credentials, and claim services, and logs actions accordingly.

classes.name: DefaultTbDeviceService
classes.description: Service class implementing device management operations such as save, delete, assign, unassign, claim, and reclaim within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a device with an access token, defaulting to the default name conflict strategy.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a device with an access token and specified name conflict strategy.

methods.name: saveDeviceWithCredentials
methods.description: Saves a device with specified credentials.

methods.name: saveDeviceWithCredentials
methods.description: Saves a device with specified credentials and name conflict strategy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a device and logs the action.

methods.name: assignDeviceToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a device to a customer.

methods.name: unassignDeviceFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns a device from a customer.

methods.name: assignDeviceToPublicCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a device to the public customer.

methods.name: claimDevice
methods.description: Claims a device for a customer.

methods.name: reclaimDevice
methods.description: Reclaims a device, unassigning it from a customer.

methods.name: assignDeviceToTenant
methods.description: Assigns a device to a new tenant.

methods.name: assignDeviceToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a device to an edge.

methods.name: unassignDeviceFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns a device from an edge.
